content:
The workbook generation failed because expected data blocks in the 'Task' sheet were empty or contained None instead of calculated values.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells in the range H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected numerical values (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, got None). This indicates a failure in the logic responsible for populating the matrix or performing the weighted bedflow calculations within the openpyxl Worksheet.
